usageNotes: Use this to update the description/comment on an existing QEMU VM snapshot — the only mutable metadata on a snapshot after it is created. The operation is synchronous and returns null on success (no task UPID). The caller must hold VM.Snapshot on /vms/{vmid}; the target node must be online and the snapshot must already exist.

examples.summary: Add a note to a pre-upgrade snapshot on VM 105

params.description: Taken before upgrading Ubuntu 22.04 → 24.04 on 2026-06-29. Safe to delete after 30-day soak.

tips: This is the only field editable after snapshot creation — snapshot name and disk state are immutable.
Returns null (HTTP 200 with empty body), not a UPID; no task polling needed.
Snapshot names follow pve-configid format (alphanumeric + underscore, max 40 chars) and cannot be renamed via this endpoint.
To list existing snapshots and their current descriptions, use get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_snapshot before calling this.
